affectedPublicSurfaces: THE DEMO PLAN-REVIEW CARD — `apps/demo/src/components/plan-review-card.tsx`, verified present 2026-09-08 (a client component importing from `@juli/ui`). It gains the stock-goal control: CHIPS FOR 30 / 60 / 90 DAYS with 60 PRE-SELECTED as the agent-proposed value (ADR-055 d.19 — the agent pre-commits a value for every field, including the ones the seller decides), beside a UNITS FIELD for a seller who would rather name the quantity. The chips and the field are two views of ONE value; the LAST EDIT WINS, and nothing may leave them silently disagreeing.

THE ZERO-VELOCITY BRANCH OF THAT SAME CONTROL, which is a rendering rule and not a styling choice. Where a SKU has ZERO VELOCITY the days figure is UNDEFINED, not infinite (#1812's named result), so ONLY THE UNITS FIELD IS OFFERED — the day chips are ABSENT. A '90 days of supply' chip on a SKU that sells nothing is a meaningless goal, and rendering it disabled rather than absent still tells the seller the number means something.

THE COMPLETION COPY — the honest end state for EACH OF THE EIGHT CAUSES (`goal_met`, `expired_stock_remaining`, `expired_goal_met`, `seller_modified`, `already_in_promotion`, `nothing_sellable`, `no_safe_discount`, `declined`), plus GOAL PROGRESS as units cleared over units to clear and DAYS OF SUPPLY BEFORE AND AFTER — the facts #1818 records. This slice RENDERS them and computes NONE of them.

THE CONFIRMATION SHEET (#1779) RESTATES THE GOAL beside the single discount proposal and its THREE consequence lines — the thirty-day window, the ≥ 1-day hold before the traffic benefit lands, and that this discount LOWERS THE FLOOR A FUTURE FLASH SALE MUST BEAT. The goal field is #1783's numeric field kind, range-validated `0 ≤ goal < sellable-after-exclusions`, and AN EDIT RE-ARMS THE HASH so the value the seller last touched is the value bound at CONFIRM. A stale hash here means the seller consents to a number they did not choose.

THE THANH LÝ CHECKLIST ITEM on the plan review and the run view, through #1786's tracked-checklist surface: seller-editable text, seller-ticked, its tick time in the ledger, GATING NO STAGE. Its copy must say plainly that Juli can NEITHER APPLY NOR VERIFY the clearance label — TikTok has no Partner API surface for it, it cannot be applied at 0 stock, and adding stock silently strips it.

SEVEN SURFACES, NO EIGHTH. This mounts on the existing card, plan review, confirmation sheet, run view, completion message with exception list, notification centre and deadline list ONLY (S-FR-1). A slice that needs an eighth surface is a signal the design is wrong — say so and stop. NO BACKEND CHANGE: `packages/contracts` and `backend/` are untouched, and every string is Vietnamese through the seller-copy sanitiser (`apps/demo/src/lib/review-seller-copy.ts`, which re-exports `SELLER_COPY_BANNED_PATTERNS` from `@juli/contracts` at `:1,25` and exposes `sanitizeSellerReviewText()` at `:27`), second person, with no internal identifier and no projected impact magnitude.

The tests exercise THE REAL COMPONENTS WITH REAL CONTRACT PAYLOADS — not snapshots and not hand-authored event JSON — because a snapshot records what the component rendered, never that the chip default is 60 or that an edit re-armed the hash. htmlRoutes: The `apps/demo` Clear Excess plan review, confirmation sheet, run view and completion message — the four rendered surfaces this slice changes, all inside the seven S-FR-1 surfaces and adding no eighth. They are served as part of the demo app's existing bundle; no new page or route is added, and no new static asset is introduced.
Every other workflow's plan review and completion message, checked as UNCHANGED — the no-op half of the claim, and the more likely place for a regression than the surface being edited.

migrationCompatibility.notes: NO SCHEMA CHANGE, NO MIGRATION AND NO DATABASE ACCESS ANYWHERE IN THIS SLICE. The diff is `apps/demo` components and their tests. The backend field this surface renders — the `stock_goal` on the card and in run state — is #1813's and already exists when this lands; the run facts are #1818's. If the field is NOT present when implementation starts, that is a blocked dependency to report, NOT a column to add from the ui-ux lane. `packages/contracts` is not touched: the only contracts coupling is the generic `SELLER_COPY_BANNED_PATTERNS` already re-exported through `apps/demo/src/lib/review-seller-copy.ts:1,25`.

rollbackAssertion.preCutoverFailureBehavior: Do not merge. The seller has no control over the stock goal on the surface, the Thanh lý checklist item is not shown, and a completed run's eight causes, goal progress and days-of-supply pair are not rendered. The backend field and the run facts still exist and are simply unrendered — which is exactly the state the previous slices leave behind. Nothing is exposed, nothing is partially applied, no data hazard: this slice writes nothing anywhere.
rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: Revert and redeploy the previous demo build. THE BACKEND FIELD REMAINS AND SIMPLY HAS NO CONTROL RENDERED OVER IT — the agent-proposed goal is still pre-committed on every card (ADR-055 d.19), so an approval that goes through without the control still carries a valid goal rather than a blank. Runs already approved with a seller-edited goal keep that goal in their run state and their params hash; the revert does not touch persisted consent. No migration and no database access means no downgrade of any kind. THE CONSEQUENCE TO STATE IN THE PR: with the completion copy gone, a completed run's named cause and facts are recorded but unreadable to the seller, and the Thanh lý reminder disappears from the plan review — the seller loses the prompt to apply a label Juli was never able to apply for them. DRAIN OR REAP EVERY RUN IN `waiting_external` BEFORE any rollback that also removes the resume path (#1816/#1817); a UI-only revert does NOT remove it and strands nothing, but a combined rollback would leave a suspended run inert with its discount still live.

doNotInfer: Do NOT compute the goal, the sellable bound, the goal progress or the days-of-supply pair in the UI. Render what #1813 and #1818 produce — asserted by rendering deliberately unusual payload values and showing the surface reports them verbatim. A UI that recomputes will disagree with the backend the first time a rule changes.

Do NOT hardcode 60. It is the AGENT-PROPOSED value carried on the payload (ADR-055 d.19); a surface that always shows 60 hides a wrong proposal. Assert by rendering a payload proposing something else.

Do NOT render a disabled day chip at zero velocity. The chips are ABSENT — a disabled '90 days of supply' chip still asserts that the number means something, and #1812's zero-velocity result is UNDEFINED, not infinite.
Do NOT send approve when the goal is out of range. Refuse IN THE SURFACE with a Vietnamese message and assert on the ABSENCE of the network call, at the exact boundary.

Do NOT let an edit leave a stale hash. An edit RE-ARMS the hash (#1783's numeric field kind) so the confirmation restates the edited value; a surface that sends the edit but keeps the old hash makes the seller consent to a number they did not choose.

Do NOT add an eighth surface. This mounts on the seven S-FR-1 surfaces only — card, plan review, confirmation sheet, run view, completion message with exception list, notification centre, deadline list. A slice that needs an eighth is a signal the design is wrong: SAY SO AND STOP.

Do NOT let the Thanh lý tick gate a stage. It is a tracked item (S-FR-12) with editable text and a ledger tick time, and it gates NOTHING in v1 — asserted by comparing the rendered stage before and after the tick.
Do NOT imply Juli will apply or verify the Thanh lý label. TikTok has no Partner API surface for it, it cannot be applied at 0 stock, and adding stock silently strips it. The copy says so plainly.

Do NOT test with snapshots or hand-authored event JSON. Use REAL CONTRACT PAYLOADS against the REAL components — a snapshot records what rendered, never that the default is 60 or that an edit re-armed the hash.

Do NOT touch `packages/contracts` or anything under `backend/`. This is the ui-ux lane; if the `stock_goal` field or the run facts are missing, that is a blocked dependency to report, not a field to add.

Do NOT let an internal identifier or a projected impact magnitude reach a seller-facing string. Every string is Vietnamese, second person, through the seller-copy sanitiser (`apps/demo/src/lib/review-seller-copy.ts:25,27`), which strips FBS/FBT/webhook/`activity_id`/backticks (S-NFR-4).
Do NOT collapse the eight causes into a default branch. Each renders its own honest end state, asserted eight times.

Do NOT infer a flash sale, a markdown or a stock write anywhere in the copy. The only lever is a thirty-day Product Discount; ADR-091 d.4 deletes the stock write and d.2 defers Flash Sale, and copy describing either would be false safety copy — the exact defect #1820 removes.
Do NOT let a model choose a rendered number. Every number on these surfaces is computed by a deterministic rule upstream (S-FR-4).
Do NOT enforce the goal on a timer in the UI, and do NOT add a second reaper policy — the surface starts no clock and owns no timeout.

Do NOT prompt for a fresh CONFIRM on the goal. It is set at approval and RESTATED at CONFIRM, never re-consented; the one act exempt from a fresh CONFIRM is the goal-triggered deactivation (#1816), and this surface reports it rather than asking about it.

Do NOT change the card's KPI tie or render a different one. `KPI_WORKFLOW_KEYS` maps `clear_excess_4` to `inventory_turnover` and `dsi` while ADR-055 d.15 says AOV; CE-NFR-3 leaves both alone and THE TIE STAYS WHATEVER THE SURFACE RENDERS TODAY.
Do NOT render a revenue reading. v1 records the facts only; the revenue reading on cleared SKUs is deferred to v2.
Do NOT reach for `Search Activities` in any copy or state. It DOES NOT EXIST at TikTok (resolved 2026-09-05 — `contract-collection.md` A-25, `endpoints.md:509`).
Do NOT touch `apps/dashboard/`, `ios/`, `backend/src/juli_backend/ai/` or `backend/src/juli_backend/workers/` — the AGT-W10A-UI lane's doNotLoad list.
